headline: US ISM Manufacturing Index Rises to 55.5 in October
summary: The US ISM manufacturing index rose to 55.5 in October from 54.5, exceeding the 54.6 forecast, as production hit its highest level since 2021.
why: The ISM manufacturing index is a major barometer of industrial health and economic momentum, closely watched by investors for inflation and growth signals.
why_moved: Better-than-expected manufacturing data driven by rising production signals stronger economic activity, boosting sentiment for growth assets.
